messages:
Devon L: Heads-up — staging canary reporting mismatch: tag `latest` resolved to digest sha256:8f3a... but build metadata says build-id=20260314-1423 which should be sha256:ed4b...
Ajay P: ugh, sounds like an ephemeral tag overwrite from concurrent CI. did the attestation for the pushed image match?
Maria K: cosign verify failed when I checked the `latest` image: `verification failed: signature does not match payload` — looks like a different build got tagged late.
Sarah T: @deploy-bot did you pause the canary? we should stop traffic if provenance/assertions don't line up. :warning:
deply-bot: deploy-bot: Canary route for service=web-api/staging paused automatically (reason: attestation_mismatch). Manual override required.
Devon L: Good. Can someone run an `aws ecr batch-get-image` to confirm both tags/digests and confirm which repo pushed last?
Ajay P: Running quick check: `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name web-api --image-ids imageTag=latest,imageTag=canary-20260314`
ci-bot: CI: build 20260314-1423 finished at 2026-03-14T14:25Z, pushed tag `canary-20260314` and attempted to promote to `latest` at 14:26:12Z. Concurrent build 20260314-1424 promoted `latest` at 14:26:30Z (race).
Maria K: So the attestation we stored under 20260314-1423 doesn't match the `latest` that the deploy picked up. The attestation for 20260314-1424 is present but not marked in release notes.
Sarah T: Options: (A) rollback canary to previous pinned digest (pre-14:25) and keep hold until we retag correctly, (B) retag the intended digest with an immutable `release-20260314-1423` tag and update deploy to use that tag, then resume canary. Thoughts?
Ajay P: I'd prefer B — retag the correct digest to a stable, immutable tag (include build id and digest). We should avoid reusing `latest` for production promotion.
Devon L: Agreed. Action list: 1) Maria to create immutable tag `release-20260314-1423` pointing at sha256:ed4b... and push cosign attestation that references that tag, 2) Ajay to update deploy config for the canary to the new tag and restart canary in paused state, 3) Sarah to draft a short postmortem blurb for release notes and CI gating fix.
Maria K: Doing step 1 now. Command: `aws ecr put-image --repository-name web-api --image-tag release-20260314-1423 --image-manifest $(aws ecr batch-get-image --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:ed4b...)` then `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/cosign release-20260314-1423`
Ajay P: I'll prepare a deploybot override config: set `imageTag: release-20260314-1423` and mark canary as manual-start.
Sarah T: I'll add a short incident note: "ephemeral tag overwrite caused canary to pick wrong digest; retagged and switched to immutable releases; CI will add short backoff to avoid promote race". cc @platform-sre for any infra followup.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: received update, will hold automated promotions for web-api until further notice.
Devon L: One more: let's add a guard in the promote workflow to only promote if cosign verify of the target `latest` matches the build-id in metadata (simple equality check). Maria, can you add that to the CI job?
Maria K: Yes — adding `cosign verify --key ksm://... $IMAGE && jq -e '.build_id == "20260314-1423"' <(curl $IMAGE_METADATA)` to promote step. Will open a small PR.
Ajay P: After retag, I'll run a canary restart with 10% traffic for 30m and watch token-level latency/cost dashboards.
Devon L: If the canary looks good, merge to prod can wait until tomorrow's 16:00 UTC change window. We won't unpause automated promotions until CI gating is patched.
Sarah T: Thanks team. I'll post a short note in #product and add to the release notes: affected users none (internal staging only).
Devon L: Great — followups: create a short ticket to prevent `latest` reuse, and consider making `latest` a guarded alias that cannot be promoted automatically without attestation match. :lock:
Maria K: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ci/+/3212 — adds cosign check and promotes backoff.
Ajay P: Retag completed and cosign signed. New tag `release-20260314-1423` -> sha256:ed4b..., verification passes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary image updated to `release-20260314-1423` in paused state. Start when ready.
Devon L: Thanks. I'll unpause after Ajay runs the manual canary and confirms dashboards.
Sarah T: Documenting in the incident log now. :memo:
